units.source_text: 他在路边停了下来，等待她。

en.t: He stopped by the roadside and waited for her.

units.source_text: 约莫过了五分钟，她好似有些憔悴朝着他走过来。

en.t: After about five minutes, she came walking toward him, looking somewhat worn out.

units.source_text: 看到他的脸，她微笑着说：“我累啦。”

en.t: When she saw his face, she smiled and said, "I am tired."

units.source_text: 他们肩并肩在有些许微光的广场上散步。

en.t: They walked side by side through the square, where there was a faint glimmer of light.

units.source_text: 这是他们第一次这样散步。

en.t: It was the first time they had walked together like this.

units.source_text: 主要能跟她在一起，他付出一切也在所不惜。

en.t: As long as he could be with her, he would not hesitate to give up everything.
